# Frozen sync plan flow: plan preview, stale refusal after a source change,
# regenerated plan applied with the confirmed revision, status readback and
# the read-only retention preview.
mkdir local
mkdir remote-files
exec sh -c 'printf "[nas]\ntype = alias\nremote = %s\n" "$1" > rclone.conf' sh $WORK/remote-files
chmod 0600 rclone.conf

exec sh -c 'printf "state: %s\nrclone_config: %s\n" "$1" "$2" > drivebridge.yaml' sh $WORK/state $WORK/rclone.conf

exec drivebridge space add --space nas --backend generic --remote nas --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576
stdout 'Space configured'

# The first plan without a baseline is refused exactly like the legacy run.
exec sh -c 'printf hello > local/a.txt'
! exec drivebridge sync plan --space nas
stderr 'resync_required'

# A resync plan freezes the preview; nothing is written yet.
exec drivebridge sync plan --space nas --resync --json
stdout '"phase":"planned"'
! exists $WORK/remote-files/a.txt

# Extract the frozen plan id for apply.
exec sh -c 'drivebridge sync plan --space nas --resync --json > plan.json'
exec sh -c 'PLAN=$(sed -n "s/.*\"plan_id\":\"\([0-9a-f]*\)\".*/\1/p" plan.json | sed -n 1p); printf %s "$PLAN" > plan.id'

# The remote side changes after the freeze: apply refuses with plan_stale.
exec sh -c 'printf late > remote-files/late.txt'
exec sh -c '! drivebridge sync apply "$(cat plan.id)" --revision 1 --json'
stdout '"plan_stale"'
exists $WORK/remote-files/late.txt

# Regenerate: the new plan sees both the local addition and the late file.
exec sh -c 'drivebridge sync plan --space nas --resync --json > plan2.json'
exec sh -c 'printf %s "$(sed -n "s/.*\"plan_id\":\"\([0-9a-f]*\)\".*/\1/p" plan2.json | sed -n 1p)" > plan.id'
exec sh -c 'grep -q late.txt plan2.json'
exec sh -c 'grep -q a.txt plan2.json'

# A wrong revision is refused before anything moves.
exec sh -c '! drivebridge sync apply "$(cat plan.id)" --revision 9 --json'
stdout '"version_conflict"'

# Apply with the confirmed revision executes the frozen set.
exec sh -c 'drivebridge sync apply "$(cat plan.id)" --revision 1 --json'
stdout '"phase":"completed"'
exists $WORK/remote-files/a.txt
exists $WORK/local/late.txt

exec sh -c '! drivebridge sync apply "$(cat plan.id)" --revision 1 --json'
stdout '"plan_not_applicable"'

# Status reads the plan back with its item page and recovery hints.
exec sh -c 'drivebridge sync status "$(cat plan.id)" --json'
stdout '"phase":"completed"'
stdout '"total_items"'

# The retention preview classifies without deleting anything.
exec drivebridge retention preview --space nas --json
stdout '"staging"'
exists $WORK/local/late.txt

# The legacy one-shot surface still works next to plans.
exec sh -c 'printf legacy > local/legacy.txt'
exec drivebridge sync --space nas --json
stdout '"status":"success"'
exists $WORK/remote-files/legacy.txt
